# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in libConfuse, please use GitHub's
built-in [Report a Vulnerability][report] feature for a private and secure
disclosure.

When reporting, include:

- A clear description of the vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce the issue.
- Potential impact of the vulnerability.

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are made on `master` and reach users in the next release.
The supported version of the project is therefore the latest release.

## Acknowledgments

We appreciate the efforts of the security community to help improve the
security of the library. Thank you for your responsible disclosure.

[report]: https://github.com/libconfuse/libconfuse/security/advisories/new
